name: The Crown of Will
summary: In Tarren Mill, Melisara seeks the heads of three ogres before Mug'Thol.

sections.title: Sniping at the Leadership
sections.body: Melisara names Targ, Muckrake and Glommus as Mug'Thol's loyal lieutenants, though she wonders what could make an ogre loyal. You are to kill all three and bring their heads to Tarren Mill. Then only Mug'Thol's head, crown and all, remains to be taken.

sections.title: What Becomes of the Heads
sections.body: Melisara remarks on the ogres' foul smell. When Mug'Thol's head arrives, all four will be set on pikes over Alterac as a warning to anyone who crosses the Dark Lady.

faq.q: Who gives this part of The Crown of Will?
aliases: who starts the crown of will
where to turn in the crown of will
faq.answer: Melisara gives you this part in Tarren Mill, where you bring the heads to her.

faq.q: Who are Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus?
faq.answer: Targ, Muckrake and Glommus are Mug'Thol's loyal lieutenants. Melisara wants their heads.
Before this part, the ogres' numbers were thinned in the second part of The Crown of Will.
